request.description: One modular TOP LEFT CORNER AND TWO SHORT RAILS for Dungeon Matcher's small portrait frame. Orthographic front-facing UI hardware, no perspective. Thin straight horizontal and vertical cool silver rails, 7 to 8 native pixels thick, forming a clean L corner; a SMALL purple diamond jewel socket approximately 13 pixels wide at the joint; short square silver clamp further along each rail. Each rail extends about 30 native pixels from the corner. Empty transparent interior, generous clear space around object. Cool silver metal bevel with muted violet shadow, single dark contour, restrained upper-left highlight, broad simple connected planes, crisp chunky pixels at the same source density as the reference. This is isolated reusable frame hardware, not a complete picture frame, panel, scene or portrait. No character, skull, text, vines, filigree, texture noise, blur or soft lighting.

style_image.usage_description: Rattlebones: use only crisp native contours and restrained simple connected shading. Do not copy skeleton anatomy, crown, cape, equipment or colors.
